hypotheses.justification: Replace the global frame on U by a frame on its basepoint path component, choosing the prescribed intersection paths there, and send all arrows in other components to 1. No arrows connect different components, so this defines a functor. The intersection lies entirely in the basepoint component by hI; consequently compatibility is unchanged. FundamentalGroupoid.descOfIsOpenCover and inclusion_comp_descOfIsOpenCover then give existence. For uniqueness, subdivide any based loop into alternating U- and V-contained segments. Every switching point lies in the intersection; connecting these points to p inside the intersection expresses the loop as a product of images of based loops in U and V. Thus those images determine every homomorphism. The point p excludes empty charts and intersection; other components and trivial groups cause no exceptions. Both hU and hV can be deleted simultaneously.

Symmetrically, construct the V frame only on its basepoint path component and assign 1 to arrows in every other component. By hI all intersection points remain in the framed component, so the compatible functors descend using FundamentalGroupoid.descOfIsOpenCover. Uniqueness follows by subdividing based loops and connecting switching points to p within the intersection, showing that the two chart fundamental groups generate the ambient fundamental group. No connectedness of V is needed. Empty charts are excluded by p, and additional components or trivial groups do not affect the argument. Both hU and hV can be deleted simultaneously.
